label: retrospective
retro
definition: The last event of a sprint, after the sprint review: the team looks at how the week went (process, tools, the definition of done) and picks the changes it will make, each filed as an issue on the backlog.
is_not: The sprint review: the review inspects the increments; the retrospective inspects the way of working.
A postmortem: a postmortem follows one incident; the retrospective follows every sprint.
A report: a report records one delegated run; the retrospective decides changes.
